title: Eight weeks in Las Vegas, playing for free, and back to New York
summary: A Las Vegas job pays well but Los Angeles offers only free party gigs, so he returns to New York and keeps fighting.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Yeah. At one point you did have - with this band, I think, you had a pretty good job in Las Vegas - didn't you?

Well, yes, but that was an unusual and unexpected job and we stayed there eight weeks. We all made a lot of money on that one - but eight weeks - there we are - back in Los Angeles again, where there's no work at all. And, if anybody-- if they did hire you and wants you, they wanted you to play for nothing; I even had guys call me up and say - why don't you guys come over - we're having a party at the pool - plenty to drink - plenty to eat -- forget about the money. So, some people think musicians just have a good time; they forget that you play
half of your life for nothing.
So, I couldn't make it on that one and, uh, I went back-- back to New York and started to fight it again and I played Toronto - I played a lot - I had good bands---
